title: Simplify and consolidate some "application flavor" functionality.
description:
1. Remove get_application_flavor() from being needed publicly
2. Add application_configuration_environment_variable() and application_extcap_dir() to replace previous public use of get_application_flavor()
3. Add set_application_flavor_by_name() to replace the need for application_name_to_flavor()
